transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 678 Girnigoe Drive?
Yes, this is 678 Girnigoe Drive. We have four people here, my husband needs oxygen and can’t leave him alone. Water’s already inside. We can’t get help from a truck or boat, and we have no seats.
I hear you’re in a tough spot. Stay safe. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Four people total. My husband can’t leave alone—he’s on oxygen.

Thank you for sharing that important detail with us. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Yes, my husband can’t leave alone—he needs oxygen. He’s not in a wheelchair.
I hear your husband needs oxygen and can’t leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
Yes, water’s inside. Husband needs oxygen and can’t leave alone. We’re stuck.
I hear you’re in a tough spot. Stay safe and calm. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats. Can’t leave alone—husband needs oxygen.
Understood, you’re staying with your husband needing oxygen. Let me read that back: 4 people; husband needs help leaving because of oxygen; water is inside. Is that right?
Yes. Four people. Husband on oxygen, can’t leave alone. Water’s inside. No truck, boat, or seats.

Got it. Stay safe. We’re listening. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.
